verdict.rationale: Motion has a live, documented REST API (docs.usemotion.com/api-reference) confirmed via probe to enforce auth on endpoints like /v1/tasks, and docs mention API access for projects/tasks — but no evidence shows dedicated endpoints for 'event types,' 'availability,' or 'bookings' as needed to build a scheduling product; the booking-page feature (embed AI Calendar) is described only as a UI widget, not an API surface. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints/schemas for event types, availability windows, and booking creation, plus any developer guide or cookbook example specifically for building scheduling into a third-party product.
